title: V/H/S: Viral
review: Step right up and see a silly magician segment, the worlds fastest BMX, and a crazy sci-fi story like something out of Half Life mixed with They Live. Is this when VHS scrapped trying to justify the existence of the tape, and embraced some interesting ideas, and variation? It's substantially more fun to watch than the preceding ones, and isn't trying to be serious at all, so I was pleasantly surprised. The most comedy in any entry in this series, at the expense of horror, and it worked for me. I know it's maligned by critics, and that's probably because professional writers can't bring themselves to condone something so dumb.
